item.title: His Brother Has Spent Decades Fighting For Justice
item.description: Nine-month-old Jacob Landin died in New Mexico in 1987 after suffering severe head injuries. His older brother Eric was initially blamed for earlier injuries despite being only six years old. The case remains open, and Eric has spent decades pushing for answers and accountability

item.title: Her Husband’s Story Did Not Match The GPS Evidence
item.description: Lynette Hooker disappeared in the Bahamas in April 2026 after her husband said she fell from their dinghy at night. Investigators later said GPS evidence appeared to conflict with his account, prompting renewed searches and a possible murder investigation. No one has been charged.

item.title: Her Family Did Not Know She Was Missing For Years
item.description: Fawn Marie Mountain was last seen in Claysburg, Pennsylvania, in 2012, but her family did not report her missing until years later. She has never been found, and Pennsylvania State Police continue to investigate her disappearance while offering a reward for information.

item.title: The Bank Robber With A Bomb Locked Around His Neck
item.description: In 2003, pizza delivery driver Brian Wells robbed a bank near Erie, Pennsylvania, with a timed explosive device secured around his neck. Police detained him shortly afterward, but the bomb detonated before it could be removed. Investigators later charged Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong and Kenneth Barnes in the plot.

item.title: The Murder That Put Pam Hupp At The Center Of The Case
item.description: Betsy Faria was found murdered in her Missouri home in 2011, and her husband was initially convicted before being exonerated. Attention later shifted to Betsy’s friend Pam Hupp, who had become the beneficiary of her life insurance policy and was eventually charged with Betsy’s murder.

item.title: She Buried Her Newborn And Said She Never Killed Her
item.description: Brooke Skylar Richardson was charged after the remains of her newborn daughter were found buried in her family’s backyard in Ohio in 2017. Prosecutors argued she intentionally killed the baby, but a jury acquitted her of the most serious charges. She was convicted only of abuse of a corpse.

item.title: Dulce Alavez Vanished From A Park In Broad Daylight
item.description: Five-year-old Dulce Maria Alavez disappeared from Bridgeton City Park in New Jersey on September 16, 2019, while playing near her younger brother. No confirmed suspect has ever been identified, and the FBI still lists her as missing while continuing to seek information about her whereabouts.

item.title: His Wife Died On The Stairs, Then An Earlier Death Resurfaced
item.description: Michael Peterson was convicted of killing his wife, Kathleen, after she was found dead at the bottom of a staircase in 2001. The case grew stranger when investigators examined another woman’s similar death years earlier. Peterson later won a new trial and entered an Alford plea to voluntary manslaughter.
